strategy_roster.name: Straddle Trail v2.40
strategy_roster.notes: A prior-candle upside stop and 20-bar trend filter are fallbacks for the event straddle because no default distances are supplied. Order-book scheduling, pending recentering, pip protection, and trailing state are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: XDidi Index Cloud Duplex
strategy_roster.notes: Fast/medium/slow lengths 5/10/20 are explicit fallbacks for the two ratio crossovers. Divergence-based persistent exits, two timeframes, method variants, and point protection are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Roman Direction Flip
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(5) is an explicit single-asset proxy for buy-state cycling because the source's position and direction memory are unavailable. The 46/31 price-step target and stop cannot be converted to percentages.

strategy_roster.name: Exp TSI CCI
strategy_roster.notes: MACD 12/26/9 is an explicit proxy for the unavailable CCI-based TSI and its EMA signal because no source lengths are supplied. The inverse crossover exits and no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: TrendGuard Scalper SSL + Hama Candle with Consolidation Zones
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > sma(close,10) and ema(close,20) > ema(close,100) and close > ema(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20)/EMA(100) and price confirmation are direct; SMA(10) is an explicit fallback for the SSL average whose period is absent. Consolidation analysis and fixed percentage exits are mentioned without numeric values.

strategy_roster.name: Lbs V12
strategy_roster.notes: The documented ATR(3) offset is applied around the prior candle extremes for the long and mirror stop orders. Trigger-hour timing, 100-point target, and 20-point trailing cannot be translated into the daily DSL.

strategy_roster.name: AIS2 Trading Robot 20005 (StockSharp port)
strategy_roster.notes: A prior 20-bar range midpoint substitutes for the prior 15-minute candle, and a mean-band cross is an exit proxy. Range-scaled 1.7 factors, fast-timeframe trailing, pause, and equity sizing are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Sector Momentum Rotation
strategy_roster.notes: Twenty-bar positive momentum is a single-ticker proxy for selecting the strongest sector; the period is an explicit fallback. Cross-sectional ranking, monthly rebalancing, rotation state, and capital allocation are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Price Impulse
strategy_roster.notes: Five-bar open ROC above 1% is an explicit OHLCV fallback because HistoryGap and ImpulsePoints have no values. Level1 buffering, cooldown, and point-based stop/target are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Futures Trading Hours RSI
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) crossing 30 retains the long entry, while a recross above 50 proxies mean reversion because the 15:00 session exit cannot be scheduled. The 08:30-15:00 filter is omitted.
